name: Columbina
storytext: Moonlit Dove, Where Lies Your Cove?
source: Reward for inviting Columbina to a duel at The Cat's Tail and claiming victory in a Friendly Fracas with her

skills.name: Moondew Cascade
skills.descriptionraw: Deals $[D__KEY__DAMAGE] $[D__KEY__ELEMENT].\nDuring this match, after opposing characters have been affected by a total of 3 instances of Lunar Reactions, if there is a card with $[K3005] attached to it in your Hand, place 1 random card in your Hand with $[K3005] attached to it on top of your deck, then deal 1 $[K107]. (Once per Round)
skills.descriptionreplaced: Deals 1 {SPRITE_PRESET#2102}<color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color>.\nDuring this match, after opposing characters have been affected by a total of 3 instances of Lunar Reactions, if there is a card with <color=#FFFFFFFF>Cost Reduction</color> attached to it in your Hand, place 1 random card in your Hand with <color=#FFFFFFFF>Cost Reduction</color> attached to it on top of your deck, then deal 1 {SPRITE_PRESET#2107}<color=#7EC236FF>Dendro DMG</color>. (Once per Round)
skills.description:
Deals 1 Hydro DMG.
During this match, after opposing characters have been affected by a total of 3 instances of Lunar Reactions, if there is a card with Cost Reduction attached to it in your Hand, place 1 random card in your Hand with Cost Reduction attached to it on top of your deck, then deal 1 Dendro DMG. (Once per Round)

skills.name: Moonsign Benediction: Moonlight, Lent Unto You

(Once per Round)
skills.descriptionreplaced: (Passive) During this match, when the opponent is affected by the <color=#FFFFFFFF>{SPRITE_PRESET#2102}{SPRITE_PRESET#2104}Electro-Charged Reaction</color>/<color=#FFFFFFFF>{SPRITE_PRESET#2102}{SPRITE_PRESET#2107}Bloom Reaction</color>/<color=#FFFFFFFF>{SPRITE_PRESET#2102}{SPRITE_PRESET#2106}Hydro Crystallize Reaction</color>, the reaction will be converted to the <color=#FFFFFFFF><color=#FFFFFFFF>Lunar-Charged</color></color>/<color=#FFFFFFFF><color=#FFFFFFFF>Lunar-Bloom</color></color>/<color=#FFFFFFFF><color=#FFFFFFFF>Lunar-Crystallize</color></color> Reaction.\nWhen the opponent is affected by the <color=#FFFFFFFF><color=#FFFFFFFF>Lunar-Charged</color></color>/<color=#FFFFFFFF><color=#FFFFFFFF>Lunar-Bloom</color></color>/<color=#FFFFFFFF><color=#FFFFFFFF>Lunar-Crystallize</color></color> Reaction: Deals 1 {SPRITE_PRESET#2104}<color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color>/{SPRITE_PRESET#2107}<color=#7EC236FF>Dendro DMG</color>/{SPRITE_PRESET#2106}<color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color>. (Once per Round)
skills.description:
(Passive) During this match, when the opponent is affected by the Electro-Charged Reaction/Bloom Reaction/Hydro Crystallize Reaction, the reaction will be converted to the Lunar-Charged/Lunar-Bloom/Lunar-Crystallize Reaction.
When the opponent is affected by the Lunar-Charged/Lunar-Bloom/Lunar-Crystallize Reaction: Deals 1 Electro DMG/Dendro DMG/Geo DMG. (Once per Round)
